name: Trentesix core
about: The base every look starts from: Discothèque's spacing, radii, borders, durations, easings, families and springs, and the look variables (what differs between looks beyond colour). A look's tokens override what differs; its colours come from its own package.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, avatar overlap step.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, field label to input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Tile padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter, between sections in a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Main content padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Above page titles on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Kbd boxes, link chips, thumbnails in rows.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Inputs, list containers, sub-field rows.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, segmented controls, avatars.

tokens.name: border-object
tokens.usage: Outline of every card, input, button and pill.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Dialogs, palette, selected presence ring.

tokens.name: stripe-band
tokens.usage: Height of each of the four rainbow stripes under the top bar.

tokens.name: duration-snap
tokens.usage: Presses, hovers, toggles' squish.

tokens.name: duration-pop
tokens.usage: Things you caused appearing: ticks, chips, popovers.

tokens.name: duration-glide
tokens.usage: Panels and drawers sliding, list items moving.

tokens.name: duration-drift
tokens.usage: Things arriving on their own: presence, live updates, page transitions.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Snap and pop: a small overshoot. Motion spring: stiffness 400, damping 22.

tokens.name: ease-glide
tokens.usage: Glide: fast out, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-drift
tokens.usage: Drift: symmetric, calm.

tokens.name: ease-shake
tokens.usage: Error shake only.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace

scale.name: display
scale.usage: The one big line on a screen: a greeting, a poster number.

scale.name: item
scale.usage: Names in rows and on cards.

scale.name: voice
scale.usage: The app speaking: a gentle note, an empty translation.

scale.name: celebrate
scale.usage: Celebrations only; at most once per session.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Things you caused appearing: ticks, chips, stamps, the pill after publishing. A visible bounce.

tokens.name: settle
tokens.usage: Things landing after a move: lifted rows, the flying title, a dialog. Bounces once.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: Lines that draw themselves: ticks, underlines, rings, the seal.

look.about: Variables whose value differs between looks beyond colour. A look overrides them in its own tokens ("look"."values").

values.name: outline
values.usage: The edge of objects: cards, tables, panels.

values.name: outline-control
values.usage: The edge of controls: buttons, switches, checkboxes.

values.name: outline-field
values.usage: The edge of a text input at rest.

values.name: outline-field-active
values.usage: The edge of a text input, hovered or focused.

values.name: border-field
values.usage: Width of a text input's edge.

values.name: divider
values.usage: A whole border value for the line between rows.

values.name: focus-ring
values.usage: Width of the focus ring, drawn 2px outside the element.

values.name: focus-edge
values.usage: The focus ring's inner edge, drawn under the outline with `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--focus-edge)`. Transparent in Folio.

values.name: press
values.usage: How far a primary button travels into its shadow when pressed.

values.name: lift
values.usage: How far a hovered object rises.

values.name: radius-button
values.usage: Corner of buttons.

values.name: radius-badge
values.usage: Corner of badges and pills.

values.name: label-size
values.usage: Size of eyebrows and section labels.

values.name: label-weight
values.usage: Weight of eyebrows and section labels.

values.name: label-tracking
values.usage: Letter spacing of eyebrows and section labels.

values.name: label-case
values.usage: text-transform of eyebrows and section labels.

values.name: field-label-size
values.usage: Size of field labels.

values.name: field-label-tracking
values.usage: Letter spacing of field labels.

values.name: field-label-case
values.usage: text-transform of field labels.

values.name: label-color
values.usage: Colour of labels.

values.name: ui-size
values.usage: Default size of UI text.

values.name: link
values.usage: Links in text.

values.name: inverse
values.usage: The one dark-on-light object: toasts, tooltips.

values.name: on-inverse
values.usage: Text on --inverse.

values.name: on-inverse-accent
values.usage: The action word in a toast (Undo, View).

values.name: on-chocolate-accent
values.usage: An accent on the top bar and sidebar.

values.name: selected-soft
values.usage: A soft selection fill.

layout.about: What layout can share. Breakpoints can't be CSS variables (a media query can't read one), so they are here and in the scripts' tokens; write them in media queries as numbers.

breakpoints.name: small
breakpoints.usage: Phones end here: one column below it.

breakpoints.name: medium
breakpoints.usage: Tablets and narrow windows: a side column can sit beside the main one from here.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.usage: Big screens: content stops growing around here.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The page's side margin: --space-4 on phones, --space-6 from the medium breakpoint.

tokens.name: reading-width
tokens.usage: The longest a line of running text should be.

tokens.name: region-gap
tokens.usage: The gap between a page's major regions.
